title: How is Saddam Hussein connected to Cookie Monster?
description:
Four real photos connect Iraq's Saddam Hussein to Cookie Monster from Sesame Street, through a defense secretary, a president and a first lady.

Saddam Hussein → Donald Rumsfeld → George W. Bush → Michelle Obama → Cookie Monster

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

Photo credits:
Photo 1 by Iraqi state television, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Saddam_rumsfeld.jpg
Photo 2 by White House photo by Paul Morse, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bush_and_Rumsfeld_shakes_hands,_November_8,_2006.jpg
Photo 3 by White House photo by Eric Draper, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bushes_with_Obamas_2.jpg
Photo 4 by Elaine Sanchez, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jill_Biden_and_Michelle_Obama_pose_with_some_of_the_cast_of_Sesame_Street,_2011.jpg
